_comment: Verified agency timezones (the 8 Coach USA/Trillium operators 562 563 664 1559 1566 1573 1574 1801: the official feed declares America/New_York for all, incl. Chicago-area ones, and Van Galder trip codes confirm it): the clock that the raw stop_times use. The source data has no agency_timezone field. A value is a zone name, or {"timezone": zone, "clock": "stop_local"} when each stop's raw time is that stop's own local time and gets shifted into the agency zone. Evidence in README.
